package.name: adhere_mujoco_hardware
package.description: AdhereMujocoHardware: a 500Hz hardware_interface::SystemInterface (ROS 2 Foxy) that owns the master MuJoCo mjModel/mjData, FossenHydrodynamics, and the raw hw_states_[36]/hw_commands_[8] buffers. Encapsulates read() -> write() (thruster lag/deadzone -> Fossen hydrodynamics + wave gusts -> mj_step) completely decoupled from the upper ROS 2 controller rate. Also hosts MujocoVisBridge, the in-process pointer bridge to the 60Hz MujocoViewer (GLFW/OpenGL) rendering frontend.
